description: validate_path / chain_walk perform no deduplication check on the chain slice. If chain contains the same Certificate at two positions (or two certificates with the same subject/SPKI), the walk proceeds without error. A chain where chain[0] == chain[1] will fail signature verification or name linkage, but the error message will be misleading (SignatureInvalid or ChainBroken rather than a 'malformed input' indication). No deduplication test exists. Should detect and reject duplicate certs to avoid misleading error attribution.
title: duplicate certs in chain are silently processed twice
